record.paper_title: Some open problems on Banach spaces
record.original_question: Is the weak metric approximation property strictly weaker than the metric approximation property? In the related dual-space form, if a dual Banach space has the approximation property, must it also have the metric approximation property?

evidence.quote: Finally, it is essential to stress that it is an open problem whether the weak MAP is strictly weaker than the MAP.
the latter problem is intimately related to the long-standing famous open AP-implies-MAP problem whether the AP of a dual Banach space implies the MAP.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a Banach space, and let $B(X)$ denote the space of bounded linear operators on $X$ and $F(X)\subset B(X)$ the subspace of finite-rank operators. Recall:

(i) $X$ has the approximation property (AP) if for every compact set $K\subset X$ and every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists $T\in F(X)$ with $\|Tx-x\|<\varepsilon$ for all $x\in K$.

(ii) $X$ has the metric approximation property (MAP) if the operators $T$ in (i) can be chosen with $\|T\|\le 1$.

(iii) $X$ has the weak metric approximation property (weak MAP) if for every Banach space $Y$, every weakly compact operator $S\in B(X,Y)$, every compact set $K\subset X$ and every $\varepsilon>0$, there exists $T\in F(X)$ with $\|ST\|\le \|S\|$ and $\|Tx-x\|<\varepsilon$ for all $x\in K$.

It is known that MAP implies weak MAP, which implies AP. Answer the following:

(a) Does there exist a Banach space that has the weak metric approximation property but does not have the metric approximation property? Equivalently, is the weak MAP strictly weaker than the MAP?

(b) If a dual Banach space $X^*$ has the approximation property, must $X^*$ also have the metric approximation property?
artifact.status_search_result: The question whether the weak metric approximation property is strictly weaker than the metric approximation property is explicitly cited as an open problem in survey articles on approximation properties, and the related question of whether AP of a dual Banach space implies MAP is the long-standing "AP-implies-MAP" problem, still unresolved as of recent surveys.

status_evidence.title: The weak metric approximation property
status_evidence.snippet: The weak metric approximation property of Banach spaces is strictly stronger than the approximation property and at least formally weaker than the metric approximation property.
status_evidence.claim: Whether weak MAP is strictly weaker than MAP is left as a (formally) open question.

status_evidence.title: History, Developments and Open Problems on Approximation Properties
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems including whether AP of a dual space implies MAP and the status of weak MAP vs MAP.
status_evidence.claim: The AP-implies-MAP problem for dual Banach spaces is listed as a long-standing open problem.
